method: Built-in ImageGen; exactly three requests in one parallel batch, no variants or retries.
label: AI-generated sample imagery. Not photographs by Sina, not products, no specific real locations.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original AI-generated sample photograph for an editorial nature journal
Primary request: a dramatic alpine mountain lake in an imaginary wilderness, not a recognizable real location.
Scene/backdrop: a calm deep blue-green lake beneath craggy stone peaks with small remnants of snow, dark evergreen forest edging the far shore, low soft cloud drifting around the distant ridges.
Style/medium: exceptionally natural, photorealistic fine-art landscape photography; restrained editorial color grading, realistic geology and water, subtle film-like texture, no fantasy elements.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 composition, wide view from a quiet rocky shoreline, immersive foreground and layered distant mountains; balanced natural framing, photograph fills the entire frame.
Lighting/mood: atmospheric early morning, soft cool light breaking through cloud, contemplative and quietly dramatic.
Color palette: rich dark pine greens, deep slate blues, muted gray stone, subtle silver highlights.
Constraints: exactly one standalone photograph. No people, wildlife, boats, buildings, signs, brands, text, border, watermark, collage, gallery UI, or specific real landmark. This will be labeled AI-generated sample content outside the image.
